_readme: Derived from the Quad Cortex's own device catalog (ModelRepo.xml, which the unit sends over USB) by cmd/import_catalog -- do not edit by hand; re-run the importer after a CorOS update. Hidden/internal models, firmware-plumbing categories and hidden parameters are dropped. A param's index is its position in the device's parameter list (hidden ones included), which is how the device addresses it; names repeat within a model (e.g. one POSITION/DISTANCE/LEVEL/PAN set per mic on dual-mic cabs), so use index to tell them apart. min/max are omitted and min_symbol/max_symbol set when the device uses a named bound (e.g. MAX_CABSIM_DB) whose numeric value lives in firmware -- treat that range as unknown.
